requirements.description: The OverlayFS class is placed at fs/overlayfs.py with the exact name OverlayFS.
must_include: placed at `fs/overlayfs.py`. The class must be named `OverlayFS`
requirements.verifier_assertion: from fs.overlayfs import OverlayFS must succeed; test_outputs.py top-level import
OverlayFS(MemoryFS()) and OverlayFS(MemoryFS(), MemoryFS()) both instantiate without error

requirements.description: When upper_fs is omitted a MemoryFS is automatically created as the writable upper layer.
must_include: automatically create a `MemoryFS` as the writable upper layer
requirements.verifier_assertion: OverlayFS(MemoryFS()) implicit upper must be writable; FSTestCases with implicit upper

requirements.description: The lower filesystem is strictly read-only; no overlay operation may modify it.
must_include: strictly read-only. No operation performed through the overlay is permitted to modify
requirements.verifier_assertion: write-COW tests: after write, lower layer byte-identical to pre-write state

requirements.description: Reads fall through to the lower layer if the resource is absent from the upper layer.
must_include: falls back transparently to the lower layer
requirements.verifier_assertion: test_read_through: lower-layer file readable without prior copy

requirements.description: Writes copy-up the lower-only file before modifying it in the upper layer.
must_include: first copy it up into the upper layer and then make the modification there

requirements.description: setinfo also triggers a copy-up for lower-only files.
requirements.verifier_assertion: test_setinfo_cow in test_outputs.py: setinfo on lower-only file must succeed without touching lower

requirements.description: Deleting a lower-only resource writes a whiteout marker to the upper layer; lower is untouched.
must_include: write a whiteout marker into the upper layer (do not touch the lower layer)

requirements.description: Whiteout markers are invisible in directory listings and all merged views.
must_include: must never appear in directory listings or any merged view
requirements.verifier_assertion: test_delete_whiteout: exists() returns False, entry absent from listdir result

requirements.description: Recreating a previously-deleted lower-layer directory produces a fresh empty directory with no stale children.
must_include: old lower-layer children must NOT reappear
requirements.verifier_assertion: test_dir_recreation_clean in test_outputs.py: children from lower absent after delete+mkdir

requirements.description: The opener registers under the protocol name 'overlay'.
requirements.verifier_assertion: fs.open_fs('overlay://') must return an OverlayFS instance in test_outputs.py

requirements.description: The implementation passes PyFilesystem2's FSTestCases suite with an empty lower layer.
requirements.verifier_assertion: FSTestCases run against OverlayFS(MemoryFS()) implicit upper in test_outputs.py

requirements.description: FSTestCases also passes when an explicit upper layer is supplied.
must_include: once with an explicit upper layer passed in
requirements.verifier_assertion: FSTestCases run against OverlayFS(MemoryFS(), MemoryFS()) explicit upper in test_outputs.py
